title: Holtec Pioneer 2 (SMR-300 at Palisades): Request for Withholding Information from Public Disclosure for Revision 1 of Enclosures to Holtec Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Limited Work Authorization Application [['E-Mail', 'Proprietary Information Review']]

documents.text:
From:           Victoria Huckabay
To:             Jake Dolecki
Cc:             Miriam Matthew; Anthony Konecni; Michelle Hayes
Subject:        Request for Withholding Determination from Public Disclosure - Revision 1 of Enclosures to the LWA Application
Date:           Tuesday, October 13, 2026 10:07:00 PM


To: Jake Dolecki
Sr. Manager, SMR Licensing and Engineering Programs
Holtec International

By letter subject “Submittal of Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Limited Work Authorization
Application” dated September 29, 2026 (Agencywide Documents Access and Management
System (ADAMS) Accession No. ML26272A332, part of package ML26272A331), Holtec
submitted an affidavit (ADAMS Accession No. ML26272A339, part of package
ML26272A331) requesting that the information contained in the following document be
withheld from public disclosure pursuant to Section 2.390, “Public inspections, exemptions,
requests for withholding,” of Title 10 of the Code of Federal Regulations (10 CFR):

       Enclosure I, General and Financial Information, Revision 1 (ADAMS Accession No.
       ML26272A333, part of package ML26272A331)

       Enclosure III, HI-2252191, “Pioneer Units 1 and 2 Preliminary Safety Analysis Report
       for Limited Work Authorization,” Revision 1 (ADAMS Accession No. ML26272A335,
       part of package ML26272A331)

       Enclosure V, Exemptions, Revision 1 (ADAMS Accession No. ML26272A337, part of
       package ML26272A331)

The NRC staff reviewed the affidavit and information provided in the letter in accordance
with the requirements of 10 CFR 2.390. Based on the statements in the affidavit, the staff
determined that the information sought to be withheld contains proprietary commercial
information and should be withheld from public disclosure. Therefore, the submitted
information marked as proprietary will be withheld from public disclosure pursuant to 10
CFR 2.390(b)(5) and Section 103(b) of the Atomic Energy Act of 1954, as amended.

If the basis for withholding this information from public inspection should change in the
future such that the information could then be made available for public inspection, you
should promptly notify the NRC. You also should understand that the NRC may have
cause to review this determination in the future, for example, if the scope of a Freedom of
Information Act request includes your information. In all review situations, if the NRC
makes a determination adverse to the above, you will be notified in advance of any public
disclosure.

If you have any questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact me.

Thank you,
Victoria Huckabay

Dockets: 05000616 and 05000617
 Victoria V. Huckabay
Senior Project Manager
OAR/DARL/ARLB2
(301) 415-5183
